sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Minimal Rose Gold Floral & Star Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elegant and trendy, this dual open ring set features a dainty flower made of mini pearl beads and a sparkling star motif with premium cubic zirconia stones. Finished in smooth gold plating, it brings a minimal yet stylish charm—perfect for daily wear or gifting to someone special.
- Material: High-quality alloy base
- Plating: Premium gold plated
- Stone Type: Faux pearl + cubic zirconia
- Design: Open adjustable ring with floral and star motifs
- Size / Fit: Free size – adjustable (comfortable for most finger sizes)
- Best Suitable For: Daily wear, party wear, gifting
